telemetry_stall.description: Freeze the vehicle-side publisher so createdDateTime stops advancing while the rFMS API stays up.
expected_symptoms: createdDateTime stops advancing; data age grows past stale_threshold_s
risks: Zenoh session lease may expire during a long pause and require reconnect on unpause
Telemetry for the paused window is not produced (no backfill)

service_crash.description: Crash the vehicle-side publisher (docker stop: SIGTERM, SIGKILL after stop_timeout_s) and restart it.
expected_symptoms: HYPOTHESIS: createdDateTime stops advancing; data age grows past stale_threshold_s
HYPOTHESIS: after docker start, fresh data takes longer to return than after unpause (cold databroker + Zenoh reconnect)
risks: fms-forwarder has no restart policy: if docker start fails it stays down (rollback not verified -> LATCHED_UNSAFE)
Zenoh client may reconnect slowly or not at all after a cold start
Telemetry for the stopped window is never produced (no backfill)
